info.name: Kunlun Tomb
info.plot: Hong Kong antique dealer Ming Shu commissions Hu Bayi, Wang Kaixuan and Shirley Yang to look for the glacier corpse within the demonic kingdom from the legends of King Gesar. Having just escaped the "worm" valley, they embark on a new journey to unravel a curse.

胡八一、Shirley杨、王胖子三人接受商人明叔的委托，前往昆仑雪山冒险，与此同时，“铁三角”也身负隐藏任务，破解雮尘珠的秘密。
